note: Per passenger, per direction, bought online at booking; min = typical low/off-peak online price, max = typical high-season online price on TLV-Europe or intra-Europe routes (airport prices are higher and not included).

W6.name: Wizz Air
W6.notes: Trolley = WIZZ Priority. Fully dynamic; long routes like TLV sit toward the top of the range. Much higher at the airport.

FR.name: Ryanair
FR.notes: Trolley = Priority & 2 Cabin Bags. RK = Ryanair UK; AL (Malta Air) not added since its IATA code is unconfirmed. Gate bag ~EUR 46+, desk bag ~EUR 55+.

U2.name: easyJet
U2.notes: Large cabin bag must be bought online (from ~GBP 6). 23 kg hold bag from ~GBP 9.49 on short routes; long/peak routes much higher. Airport hold bag ~GBP 40-50.

LY.name: El Al
LY.notes: Lite includes an 8 kg trolley, but on Europe routes since May 2025 it must be checked at the counter/gate for free. USD 90 is the quoted Europe add-bag fee (late/near-departure); the USD 50 lower bound for early online purchase is an estimate, not verified.

6H.name: Israir
6H.source: https://www.kikar.co.il/teufa/t8g8bu (price table for bookings from 2026-03-01; israir.co.il behind a queue page)
6H.notes: Fixed prices: trolley (10 kg) USD 30 online / 40 airport; first bag USD 60 online / 100 airport. Ynet (2026-03-05) reports first bag USD 65; a further Oct 2026 ancillary increase was reported but figures not confirmed.

IZ.name: Arkia
IZ.notes: Fixed prices: trolley (8 kg) USD 25 in advance, 20 kg bag USD 50 in advance (USD 20/45 per the July 2025 announcement). Airport bag USD 90 (EUR 85 at EU airports).

PC.name: Pegasus Airlines
PC.notes: Since Feb 2026 Light includes only a 3 kg under-seat item; 8 kg cabin bag is add-on (price not found) and comes with Saver. Checked range is a third-party estimate; airport ~EUR 50/piece.

BT.name: airBaltic
BT.notes: Official: checked bag from EUR 24.99 per direction online; max is an estimate for peak/long routes. MINI has personal item only; BASIC includes an 8 kg cabin bag - cabin-bag add-on price not published.

VY.name: Vueling
VY.notes: Bag is 25 kg. Some summaries quote up to ~EUR 99 on peak dates; airport ~EUR 70.

XQ.name: SunExpress
XQ.source: https://www.sunexpress.com/en-gb/book/extras-more/book-extra-luggage ; https://www.sunexpress.com/en-gb/book/extras-more/upgrade-fare (official, via search snippets; pages return 403 to fetch)
XQ.notes: SunLight = 4 kg personal item only; 8 kg cabin bag add-on price not found. Cheapest bag route is upgrading to SunEco+ (from EUR 8, includes 20-30 kg); a standalone 20 kg prepaid package is from EUR 69.99.

BZ.name: Blue Bird Airways
BZ.notes: IATA BZ confirmed (ICAO BBG). Fixed online prices: carry-on 8 kg EUR 25 (USD 29), 20 kg bag EUR 52 (USD 60); airport EUR 33 / EUR 99.

HV.name: Transavia
HV.notes: Basic = under-seat item only; overhead bag comes with Smart/Max, standalone add-on price not found (unbooked at gate EUR 60). 20 kg bag from ~EUR 36 online, ~EUR 80 at airport.

A3.name: Aegean Airlines
A3.notes: Light: 0 checked bags; one cabin piece (either 8 kg carry-on or personal item). Price range from third-party summaries (EUR 10-30 short routes, ~USD 16-70 overall); use Aegean's calculator.

LH.name: Lufthansa
LH.notes: Light includes an 8 kg carry-on; bag ~EUR 65 online on FRA-FCO. From 27 Oct 2026 a cheaper Economy Basic (personal item only, no trolley) exists on European flights - if Google shows Basic, trolley is NOT included.

LX.name: SWISS
LX.notes: Bag ~CHF 73 online on European flights. Same group Economy Basic caveat as LH from 27 Oct 2026.

OS.name: Austrian Airlines
OS.source: No Austrian-specific source found; assumed same as Lufthansa Group Light pricing
OS.notes: Unverified - mirrors LH/LX. Same group Economy Basic caveat from 27 Oct 2026.

TK.name: Turkish Airlines
TK.notes: EcoFly includes 8 kg cabin bag. Checked bag removed from EcoFly on medium-haul international routes (2022) and short-haul Europe EcoFly is hand-luggage only; whether TLV routes include 20 kg could not be confirmed. Add-on price not found (per-kg ~EUR 8-32).

AZ.name: ITA Airways
AZ.notes: Light includes 8 kg carry-on. Listed per-segment: Europe EUR 70, Italy EUR 60, Israel EUR 100; online prepay may be somewhat cheaper.
